barcodes.title: Barcodes (EAN / UPC)
barcodes.description: Product barcodes, one per line: EAN-13, EAN-8 or UPC-A. Dashes and spaces are fine. Each barcode returns exactly the matching product.

searches.title: Product name searches
searches.description: Free text searches like a product name or a brand ("oat milk", "lindt dark chocolate"). Each search returns the best matches.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Matches per search
maxResultsPerQuery.description: How many best matches to return for each name search. Barcodes always return one.

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Stop after this many rows in total.
